description: This file implements the HmacSerializable class, which provides serialization and deserialization of data with HMAC-based integrity checks, mainly used for secure environment operations involving TPM keys in the Android Open Source Project.

classes.name: HmacSerializable
classes.description: Class for secure serialization/deserialization with HMAC validation, encapsulating TPM key operations.

methods.name: HmacSerializable(TpmResourceManager & resource_manager,std::function<TpmObjectSlot (TpmResourceManager &)> signing_key_fn,uint32_t digest_size,Serializable * wrapped,const Serializable * aad)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the HmacSerializable object with resource manager, key retrieval function, digest size, wrapped serializable, and optional additional authenticated data.

methods.name: size_t SerializedSize() const
methods.description: Calculates the total size of the serialized data, including digest and wrapped data size.

methods.name: uint8_t * Serialize(uint8_t * buf,const uint8_t * end) const
methods.description: Serializes data along with HMAC, ensuring data integrity using TPM-based HMACs.

methods.name: bool Deserialize(const uint8_t ** buf_ptr,const uint8_t * end)
methods.description: Deserializes data, verifying HMAC to ensure integrity before inner deserialization.

methods.name: std::optional<std::vector<uint8_t>> AppendAad(const uint8_t * sensitive,size_t sensitive_size) const
methods.description: Appends additional authenticated data (AAD) to the signed data for HMAC calculation.
